description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Developer (WordPress) based in the United States. 

 This remote opportunity offers broad technical ownership across a network of approximately 15 websites and a growing ecosystem of digital products, APIs, and tools serving gaming and fandom communities. You will work primarily with WordPress and Cloudflare, developing and maintaining the platforms that power multiple online brands. From custom plugins and themes to edge computing services and integrations, you will take features from initial scoping through development, testing, deployment, and monitoring. Working closely with Product, Commercial, Syndication, and Editorial teams, you will help improve platform performance, security, reliability, and functionality. The role combines hands-on full-stack engineering with practical problem-solving and opportunities to work across a diverse technology stack. It is well suited to an independent developer who enjoys taking ownership and delivering solutions from idea to production.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Develop and maintain the WordPress network



 
 Build, enhance, and maintain custom WordPress themes, plugins, and must-use plugins (mu-plugins) across a network of approximately 15 websites.



 
 Maintain shared functionality, including custom Gutenberg blocks, polls, infinite scrolling, and content recirculation features.



 
 Manage plugin and security updates across the network, ensuring consistency and reliability.



 
 Support the technical infrastructure of multiple digital brands and publishing platforms.





 
 Build and support digital products



 
 Maintain and improve websites and products serving gaming and fandom communities, including Pro Game Guides, Destructoid, BloxInformer, BloxGuardian, and FruityBlox.



 
 Maintain the Codes Hunter Chrome extension and its supporting API.



 
 Develop and enhance features that improve user experience, content discovery, and platform capabilities.





 
 Develop Cloudflare services and APIs



 
 Build and maintain Cloudflare Workers and related services using D1, KV, R2, and Durable Objects.



 
 Develop and support APIs and backend functionality across the platform ecosystem.



 
 Manage migrations, including transitions from third-party services to Cloudflare infrastructure.



 
 Maintain CI/CD workflows and deployment automation through GitHub Actions.





 
 Support advertising, syndication, and analytics



 
 Integrate and maintain advertising partner technologies across the website network.



 
 Build and maintain partner feeds and content syndication integrations.



 
 Implement and track Snowplow events to support product and audience analytics.



 
 Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and other performance indicators.





 
 Own the development lifecycle



 
 Take responsibility for features from technical scoping and implementation through testing, deployment, and production monitoring.



 
 Collaborate with Product, Commercial, Syndication, and Editorial stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.



 
 Maintain clear pull requests, technical documentation, and development workflows.



 
 Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.






 Requirements


 
 Strong hands-on experience with PHP and WordPress, including custom theme, plugin, and block development.



 
 Experience developing and maintaining WordPress REST APIs and extending WordPress functionality.



 
 Solid understanding of authentication and web security fundamentals, including OAuth, sessions, HMAC, and rate limiting.



 
 Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, with the ability to contribute to front-end development.



 
 Proficiency with Git, pull requests, staged environments, and CI/CD workflows.



 
 Understanding of web performance and technical SEO, including Core Web Vitals, caching, sitemaps, and redirects.



 
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical tasks, and deliver features through to production.



 
 Strong written communication skills in English, including the ability to produce clear pull requests and technical documentation.



 
 Practical experience using AI coding agents, with the ability to assess, test, and critically review their generated code.




 Nice to have:


 
 Experience with WordPress VIP.



 
 Knowledge of Chrome extension development, particularly Manifest V3.



 
 Experience with Python, FastAPI, and Firestore.



 
 Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers and services such as D1, KV, R2, Durable Objects, and Vectorize.



 
 Experience with dbt, SQL analytics, and Snowplow.



 
 Familiarity with Stripe, Beehiiv, and SparkPost.



 
 Knowledge of Roblox games, APIs, and related development tools.



 
 Experience with React Native or Expo app development, or the ability to learn these technologies quickly.



 
 Familiarity with front-end frameworks and tools such as Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap CSS, and Gutenberg.



 
 Experience with analytics and experimentation tools such as GA4, Lightdash, and GrowthBook.




 Benefits


 
 Fully remote position, open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.



 
 Full-time employment opportunity.



 
 Broad technical ownership across a network of websites, APIs, and digital products.



 
 Opportunity to work with a diverse modern technology stack spanning WordPress, PHP, React, Cloudflare, Python, and analytics tools.



 
 Hands-on involvement in platform architecture, infrastructure improvements, product development, and technical problem-solving.



 
 Close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across Product, Commercial, Syndication, and Editorial.
